sql: SELECT RDB$GET_CONTEXT('SYSTEM','ENGINE_VERSION') AS "ENGINE_VERSION", MON$DATABASE_NAME AS "DATABASE_NAME" FROM MON$DATABASE

SELECT TRIM(RDB$RELATION_NAME) AS "NAME", RDB$RELATION_TYPE AS "KIND", RDB$DESCRIPTION AS "DESCRIPTION", RDB$VIEW_SOURCE AS "VIEW_SOURCE", TRIM(RDB$EXTERNAL_FILE) AS "EXTERNAL_FILE" FROM RDB$RELATIONS WHERE COALESCE(RDB$SYSTEM_FLAG,0)=0 ORDER BY 1

SELECT TRIM(r.RDB$RELATION_NAME) AS "TABLE_NAME", TRIM(r.RDB$FIELD_NAME) AS "NAME", r.RDB$FIELD_POSITION AS "POSITION", TRIM(r.RDB$FIELD_SOURCE) AS "DOMAIN_NAME", f.RDB$FIELD_TYPE AS "TYPE_CODE", f.RDB$FIELD_SUB_TYPE AS "SUB_TYPE", f.RDB$FIELD_LENGTH AS "BYTE_LENGTH", f.RDB$CHARACTER_LENGTH AS "CHAR_LENGTH", f.RDB$FIELD_PRECISION AS "NUM_PRECISION", f.RDB$FIELD_SCALE AS "NUM_SCALE", r.RDB$NULL_FLAG AS "COLUMN_NOT_NULL", f.RDB$NULL_FLAG AS "DOMAIN_NOT_NULL", r.RDB$DEFAULT_SOURCE AS "COLUMN_DEFAULT", f.RDB$DEFAULT_SOURCE AS "DOMAIN_DEFAULT", f.RDB$COMPUTED_SOURCE AS "COMPUTED_SOURCE", f.RDB$VALIDATION_SOURCE AS "VALIDATION_SOURCE", TRIM(cs.RDB$CHARACTER_SET_NAME) AS "CHARACTER_SET", TRIM(co.RDB$COLLATION_NAME) AS "COLLATION_NAME", r.RDB$DESCRIPTION AS "DESCRIPTION", f.RDB$DIMENSIONS AS "DIMENSIONS", TRIM(r.RDB$GENERATOR_NAME) AS "IDENTITY_GENERATOR", r.RDB$IDENTITY_TYPE AS "IDENTITY_TYPE" FROM RDB$RELATION_FIELDS r JOIN RDB$RELATIONS t ON t.RDB$RELATION_NAME=r.RDB$RELATION_NAME JOIN RDB$FIELDS f ON f.RDB$FIELD_NAME=r.RDB$FIELD_SOURCE LEFT JOIN RDB$CHARACTER_SETS cs ON cs.RDB$CHARACTER_SET_ID=f.RDB$CHARACTER_SET_ID LEFT JOIN RDB$COLLATIONS co ON co.RDB$CHARACTER_SET_ID=f.RDB$CHARACTER_SET_ID AND co.RDB$COLLATION_ID=COALESCE(r.RDB$COLLATION_ID,f.RDB$COLLATION_ID) WHERE COALESCE(t.RDB$SYSTEM_FLAG,0)=0 ORDER BY 1,3

SELECT TRIM(c.RDB$RELATION_NAME) AS "TABLE_NAME", TRIM(c.RDB$CONSTRAINT_NAME) AS "NAME", TRIM(c.RDB$CONSTRAINT_TYPE) AS "KIND", TRIM(c.RDB$INDEX_NAME) AS "INDEX_NAME", TRIM(c.RDB$DEFERRABLE) AS "DEFERRABLE", TRIM(c.RDB$INITIALLY_DEFERRED) AS "INITIALLY_DEFERRED", TRIM(r.RDB$CONST_NAME_UQ) AS "REFERENCED_CONSTRAINT", TRIM(r.RDB$UPDATE_RULE) AS "UPDATE_RULE", TRIM(r.RDB$DELETE_RULE) AS "DELETE_RULE" FROM RDB$RELATION_CONSTRAINTS c JOIN RDB$RELATIONS t ON t.RDB$RELATION_NAME=c.RDB$RELATION_NAME LEFT JOIN RDB$REF_CONSTRAINTS r ON r.RDB$CONSTRAINT_NAME=c.RDB$CONSTRAINT_NAME WHERE COALESCE(t.RDB$SYSTEM_FLAG,0)=0 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT TRIM(i.RDB$RELATION_NAME) AS "TABLE_NAME", TRIM(i.RDB$INDEX_NAME) AS "NAME", i.RDB$UNIQUE_FLAG AS "IS_UNIQUE", i.RDB$INDEX_INACTIVE AS "INACTIVE", i.RDB$INDEX_TYPE AS "DIRECTION", TRIM(i.RDB$FOREIGN_KEY) AS "REFERENCED_INDEX", i.RDB$SEGMENT_COUNT AS "SEGMENTS", i.RDB$STATISTICS AS "SELECTIVITY", i.RDB$EXPRESSION_SOURCE AS "EXPRESSION_SOURCE", i.RDB$CONDITION_SOURCE AS "CONDITION_SOURCE", i.RDB$DESCRIPTION AS "DESCRIPTION" FROM RDB$INDICES i JOIN RDB$RELATIONS t ON t.RDB$RELATION_NAME=i.RDB$RELATION_NAME WHERE COALESCE(t.RDB$SYSTEM_FLAG,0)=0 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT TRIM(s.RDB$INDEX_NAME) AS "INDEX_NAME", TRIM(s.RDB$FIELD_NAME) AS "COLUMN_NAME", s.RDB$FIELD_POSITION AS "POSITION" FROM RDB$INDEX_SEGMENTS s JOIN RDB$INDICES i ON i.RDB$INDEX_NAME=s.RDB$INDEX_NAME JOIN RDB$RELATIONS t ON t.RDB$RELATION_NAME=i.RDB$RELATION_NAME WHERE COALESCE(t.RDB$SYSTEM_FLAG,0)=0 ORDER BY 1,3

SELECT TRIM(RDB$TRIGGER_NAME) AS "NAME", TRIM(RDB$RELATION_NAME) AS "TABLE_NAME", RDB$TRIGGER_SEQUENCE AS "POSITION", RDB$TRIGGER_TYPE AS "TYPE_CODE", RDB$TRIGGER_INACTIVE AS "INACTIVE", RDB$SYSTEM_FLAG AS "SYSTEM_FLAG", RDB$TRIGGER_SOURCE AS "SOURCE", RDB$DESCRIPTION AS "DESCRIPTION", RDB$VALID_BLR AS "VALID_BLR" FROM RDB$TRIGGERS WHERE COALESCE(RDB$SYSTEM_FLAG,0)=0 ORDER BY 2,3,1

SELECT TRIM(c.RDB$CONSTRAINT_NAME) AS "CONSTRAINT_NAME", TRIM(c.RDB$TRIGGER_NAME) AS "TRIGGER_NAME", t.RDB$TRIGGER_SOURCE AS "SOURCE" FROM RDB$CHECK_CONSTRAINTS c LEFT JOIN RDB$TRIGGERS t ON t.RDB$TRIGGER_NAME=c.RDB$TRIGGER_NAME ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT TRIM(RDB$DEPENDENT_NAME) AS "DEPENDENT_NAME", RDB$DEPENDENT_TYPE AS "DEPENDENT_TYPE", TRIM(RDB$DEPENDED_ON_NAME) AS "TARGET_NAME", RDB$DEPENDED_ON_TYPE AS "TARGET_TYPE", TRIM(RDB$FIELD_NAME) AS "COLUMN_NAME", TRIM(RDB$PACKAGE_NAME) AS "PACKAGE_NAME" FROM RDB$DEPENDENCIES ORDER BY 1,3,5
